requirements: Add bottom-right positioning for the second secondary label.
Improve AI prediction prompts and output parsing robustness while retaining provider settings and other task modes.
changes: Add BottomRight to the existing second-label control, with physical-right alignment, adjustable padding and unchanged row-override precedence, main centering and directional swipe behavior.
Translate the new option in all eight existing resource locales.
Use quoted JSON input and explicit insert_text candidates for remote short predictions; prioritize plausible, distinct results over filling the configured quota.
Keep long-form, question-answer and translation text contracts; retain lightweight local-model continuation prompts and remove filler/minimum-character pressure.
Decode JSON strings with the standard serializer. Validate candidate object fields, recover only complete streamed objects, skip invalid values and reject structured API errors as suggestions.
Preserve insertion whitespace, punctuation, names and emoji joiners; remove broad keyword false positives while retaining protocol filtering and legacy-format compatibility.
Do not seed short completion output with the user's typed prefix, omit empty assistant messages, honor thinking state and allow literal less-than characters in completion results.
Update maintenance policy and the existing weekly prompt without changing its Friday 06:00 Asia/Shanghai schedule.
